A genuine wash, not an absence of information -- no edge to act on with real capital. Sitting out is the considered call, not a default.
Same technical pullback-in-uptrend shape as BTC, no offsetting news signal -- falls back to the barely-positive overall sentiment. Weak signal either way. No entry.

Most balanced technical picture of the three (MACD turned bullish alongside the golden-cross) and the sharpest pullback off its own peak, but still no corroborating news and only a near-neutral crypto signal. Worth re-checking next tick if the MACD bullish cross holds or SOL-specific news appears.
